environment: owned disposable macOS PostgreSQL; synthetic storage records only
sample_shape: 100 rooms, 1000 sender identities, half group / half direct; operation metadata present; one bulk INSERT
limits: Not application sends, throughput, production traffic or an approved capacity forecast.
Statement WAL excludes commit records and unrelated write paths; isolated cluster LSN advance is separately reported.
Bulk transaction, B-tree fill, row shape, checkpoint timing, replication and other tables change actual costs.

INSERT INTO im_v2.message_send_completions
(room_id,sender_user_id,client_message_id,fingerprint_version,request_fingerprint,message_id,event_id,
 room_sequence,timeline_sequence,accepted_membership_revision,group_capacity_class,direct_recipient_user_id,
 created_at,operation_fingerprint,operation_resolved_at_ms)
SELECT md5('room-'||(i%100))::uuid,md5('sender-'||(i%1000))::uuid,md5('client-'||i)::uuid,3,
 decode(md5('request-'||i)||md5('request-2-'||i),'hex'),md5('message-'||i)::uuid,md5('event-'||i)::uuid,
 i/100+1,i/100+1,1,CASE WHEN i%2=1 THEN 'standard' END,
 CASE WHEN i%2=0 THEN md5('recipient-'||(i%1000))::uuid END,clock_timestamp(),
 decode(md5('operation-'||i)||md5('operation-2-'||i),'hex'),1793481600000
FROM generate_series(1,10000) i;
